user_request: Implement all backend changes required to support the 2026-09-21 UI redesign, then implement the UI itself — every page discussed: Shepherd, Flock, Projects, Settings (plus the Queues and Kanban placeholders). Route through cc10x: PLAN -> BUILD -> QA (Playwright) -> bug fixes until QA passes. Run fully autonomously; decide where decisions are needed; on a real blocker move to another part of the effort; stop only when done or fully blocked, then summarise work and gaps.

U2: the Needs-You rail is out of the shell; Flock page only if it returns. Reverses section 12's 'visible at all times' - needs its own decision row.
D65: the autonomy control is Settings-only.
U15: model/engine per spawned session deferred; no precedence rule adopted.
U16: cards take a wash of their bucket colour; the legend is coloured glyph + text.
U1: one info button opens a sheet explaining all eight buckets.
Design: D61's cascade lives in the verb, not ON DELETE CASCADE. No session table rebuild.
Design: migration 004 uses ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN (probed working on SQLite 3.45.1).
Design: Unassigned is the reserved id 'unassigned', seeded by the migration.
Design: the page never sorts; fleet_bucket_sort_key is the only order.
Design: the Google Fonts link is dropped for a system font stack.
Design: removing the rail from the shell gets a numbered decision row (D66).
RD-1 APPROVED: upsert_workspace is deleted, not aliased. Once binding stops creating projects it has no caller in src/, and an alias would keep the match-on-name defect reachable.

RD-2 APPROVED: signals/discovery.py and its test file are deleted. discover_repos() has no caller in src/ and its sole documented justification (workspace.root_path) is removed by 004. It can return as an add_repo directory scanner when something needs it.

RD-3 APPROVED: workspace.last_activity_at is derived at read time from MAX(session.last_event_at), not written. Correct by construction, no new write path, and it stops a column that is always NULL being projected to the UI.

D67 (new spec row): the session view relocates into the Flock's third pane rather than being deleted. session.js, terminal.js and vendor/xterm.js are RETAINED and reachable from that pane. Section 12's Page 3 is rewritten as a pane, not a page. Reason: the owner asked for a three-pane Flock whose third pane is shaped like the Shepherd page; they never asked to lose the live pty view, and removing xterm would be a silent capability regression plus 16 retirements bought for nothing.

The stop-summary strip (#stop-summary, #unknown-rate, #low-confidence) is KEPT, in the Flock page header beside the legend. Reason: principle 5 - the unknown rate is counted and displayed, never hidden - and it is the headline metric section 12 puts on the fleet page. Preserves three frozen palette ids rather than retiring them.

D21's next_actions list relocates from the session CARD to the session PANE. U7's four-item card stands; section 12 already says the same list renders in the session view header. Capability preserved, U7 honoured, and most of test_fleet_page.py's assertions become body rewrites pointing at the new location rather than retirements.
Router correction: the frozen node-id count is 1480 (grep -c '::'), not 1482 (wc -l). The dispatch brief was wrong; the plan was right.

RD-4 DECIDED, reversing the design's file-layout row: escape.js is KEPT, byte-unchanged. UNREACHABLE_BY_DESIGN's reason string quotes the very test the retirement would remove, so deleting it either leaves a stale exemption citing a test that no longer collects or forces a third edit. One retirement, one post_milestone entry and one constant edit, all bought for tidiness. post_milestone drops 7 -> 6; retirements 17 -> 16.

Router correction to N2: reads.list_workspaces DOES have ORDER BY name (reads.py:102). The seeded 'Unassigned' sorts FIRST under BINARY collation (uppercase before lowercase), so all 8 list_workspaces()[0] sites read Unassigned instead of their own project. Deterministic, not flaky - it fails identically everywhere and cannot hide. The count is 8, not 10. The repair is selecting by name or captured id, never by position.

F13 DECIDED: tests/tools/test_render_check_args.py opens with pytest.importorskip('playwright'), and T0.1's exit asserts the suite still collects and passes without playwright installed. Same rule A6 states for esprima; marker deselection does not help because -m deselects after import.

Router: pass-2 findings are applied as a diff-scoped AMENDMENT rather than escalated. The two-pass fresh-review cap is spent, but all 15 findings carry named mechanical fixes and none is an owner decision. The amendment lane is uncapped and exists for exactly this case.

F6 pushback ACCEPTED: the planner's sink-to-module walk is right and the review's was not. Verified independently - 2520 renderLegend, 2858 BACK_BUTTON (flock.js); 2688 bylineMark, 2796/2814/2837 renderDetail (session.js, per D67); 3101 BACK_BUTTON_P (projects.js); 3617 panelHead (settings.js). T5.3 and T7.1 rewrite no sinks at all, so this removes work rather than moving it.

tools_projects.py is deliberately the one new module that is NOT pure: it runs the git probe, because git_common_dir is D48's binding key and a guessed value silently breaks session-to-project binding. The toolsurface->signals edge already exists at tools_m1.py:33.
inline_fallback_reason: task_primitive_unavailable: this harness exposes no TaskCreate/TaskList/TaskGet. The task graph is tracked in this artifact; every cc10x gate still runs.

intent.goal: Ship the projects backend (D57-D61) and the redesigned dark-only web UI (U1-U18) so that Shepherd, Flock, Projects and Settings are real pages backed by real verbs, verified in a real browser.
non_goals: M5 queues / work-item providers (W3) beyond configuration-only placeholders
Credentials / multi-user auth (credentials-and-auth.md, four open questions)
Queues and Kanban beyond nav placeholders (W5)
constraints: Spec section 3 decision log is law: D1-D65 plus D38.1. No silent reversal.
mypy --strict over src/ with disallow_any_explicit, no Any.
Downward-only imports; 105 AST boundary rules in tests/boundaries/ must stay green.
store/ exposes domain verbs returning dataclasses (D33). No SQL at call sites.
No shell=True anywhere (section 13); argv lists only.

web/static/ is byte-frozen by tests/boundaries/consumer_manifest.json. Every path whose bytes differ from the step-0b baseline - created and deleted files included - appears in exactly one of rebase.regenerated_paths or post_milestone.edits, never both. SIX post_milestone entries, one per path; entries are per PATH, not per edit. chat.js may be edited but never renamed or deleted.
No node/npm/tsc on this host: plain ES modules, no build step (D51).
Renames land in core.stops.PALETTE, not a second UI label table (test_palette_matches_core_stops).
[hidden] display reset must be in the real stylesheet (U18); the artifact wrapper supplied it and web/static does not.
tmux: never a bare kill-server; -L on every invocation; never touch the shepherd socket.
Never write under ~/.claude/; settings.json sha 375e53220773a12f0a2a7a666740f7fb20d31b2989b250e4076957d026b5d6ac must not change.
Planted violations are inert fixtures only, never live source the suite executes.
acceptance_criteria: Migration 004 drops workspace.root_path, adds workspace.description, replaces repo.workspace_id with a repo-project join table (D60), forward-only, with 001-003 untouched.
admission.py allowlist is the registered repo paths alone; the workspace-root branch and its T11-1 special case are gone.
upsert_workspace no longer matches on name; identity is workspace.id. The /work/api vs /personal/api collapse is proven fixed by a test.

Five verbs registered as ToolDefs and reachable from both the master and the HTTP API: create_project, rename_project, delete_project, add_repo, remove_repo, with create_project/add_repo/delete_project blast_class=local_destructive.
list_repos has a ToolDef and a route.
Unassigned (D59) is a reserved project and the policy lives in bind_cwd_to_repo.
delete_project forgets, cascading to sessions; running sessions force the three-way choice (kill / orphan to Unassigned / cancel) rather than dying silently.
core.stops.PALETTE carries stranded / limit exceeded / unknown; Bucket values unchanged; the 90-day stop log is unaffected.
The UI ships as a dark-only redesign with a collapsible side pane and the six nav entries; Shepherd, Flock, Projects and Settings are functional; Queues and Kanban are declared placeholders.
tools/render_check.py passes at 390x844 and 1280x900: zero console errors, every page opens, no horizontal overflow.
Full suite green and mypy --strict clean at the end of every phase.
QA route runs against the built UI with Playwright and passes.
